//: Every app that installs @mavenmm/dev-library. Single source of truth for rollouts — scripts/consumers.sh reads it, and so should you. Adding an app? Add it HERE, not to a script.

apps.name: PAAB App
apps.notes: Highest feedback volume — the canary. Video enabled.

apps.name: Newsletter
apps.notes: Needs npm >= 11.16.0 — older npm cannot install a git dep with min-release-age set.

apps.name: Maven Home
apps.notes: Furthest behind. Jumping from v0.3.0 also picks up shadow DOM (v0.4.0) and the Record-video default (v0.5.2). Roll out ALONE so a failure isn't ambiguous.

apps.name: Status Update
apps.notes: VITE_FEEDBACK_VIDEO not set locally — confirm it exists in the Netlify build env or the meter never renders.

apps.name: Maven Dashboard
apps.notes: pnpm WORKSPACE (server/ui/shared) — not npm. The dep lives in ui/ but the lockfile is pnpm-lock.yaml at the repo ROOT, so a bump stages ui/package.json plus the root lockfile. Netlify's base dir is configured in the Netlify UI, not netlify.toml — verify there if a bump appears not to deploy.

apps.name: Copydeck
apps.notes: Deploys to a droplet via .github/workflows/deploy.yml on merge — NOT Netlify. Dep lives in app/.

worker.name: maven-feedback-worker
worker.notes: Consumes /core only. Task creation and the Teamwork/Vimeo/summary pipeline live here, so /core fixes reach ALL apps with this one deploy.

//packageManager: npm unless stated. pnpm apps are workspaces: install runs at the repo root with --filter <workspacePackage>, and the lockfile is pnpm-lock.yaml at the root, NOT beside the package.json.
